title: [LOGGED OUT] Phone burger menu close button has a name for screen readers
reason: The red close (x) in the phone menu is an img with empty alt inside plain divs: no button role, no accessible name, not focusable

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser with phone emulation (iPhone 14 size, 390x844) and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Page loaded at 390x844 (iPhone user agent); cookie banner and Add It to Home Screen banner shown

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
If an "Add It to Home Screen" banner is shown at the bottom, close it with its X button (never click its "Claim").
steps.saw: Closed with the X (Close pwa banner); Claim not clicked

steps.text: Click the green burger button at the top left.
steps.saw: Menu opened with Home, Store, Reward chain, Clan reward, Loyalty shop, Login and a red close (x) top right

steps.text: Read the role and accessible name of the red close (x) button of the menu.
steps.saw: Close (x) is IMG.burger-menu__close-button with alt="", inside DIV > DIV.burger-menu__close-wrapper; no role, no aria-label, no title, no tabindex; it is absent from the accessibility snapshot (not a button, no name)

steps.text: Is the close (x) a button with an accessible name (for example "Close menu")?
steps.saw: No: it is a decorative image with empty alt, not a button, and has no accessible name

steps.text: Click the red close (x) button of the menu.
steps.saw: Clicked the close (x) image; menu closed and the home page is shown again
